name: Unified chat + agent ("one Claude") conversation
what: Since 2026-09-16 the user no longer picks a Chat vs Cowork mode: any conversation can answer quickly or run a long agentic task (research, spreadsheets, decks) and return editable files.
how: Claude classifies the request and, when agentic work is needed, attaches an Anthropic-managed per-conversation VM/sandbox; quick answers stay in the chat path. Rollout gradual for Pro/Max; Enterprise via "Chat and Cowork unified (beta)" toggle.
verevonRelevance: This is the exact product shape Verevon chat/agent pages target: one composer that escalates to a sandboxed run only when needed; Model Plane sessions/runs should be the escalation primitive.
notes: Dated 2026-09-16 in release notes. Mode selection removed; permission setting (Auto/Manual) lives in the message box.

name: Streaming responses with expandable thinking summary
what: While generating, a "Thinking" indicator with a timer is shown; an expandable "Thinking" section above the answer shows a summary of the reasoning. Thinking can be truncated with a note when safety systems flag it.
how: Thinking summaries (not raw CoT) streamed ahead of the visible answer; summaries are the UI contract, raw reasoning is withheld.
verevonRelevance: Verevon should stream a reasoning-summary channel separate from the answer channel, with a timer and collapsible panel.
notes: Summarized rather than verbatim thinking is a deliberate anti-distillation choice (see model switching record).

name: Artifacts side panel (typed outputs: Docs, Slides, Design, Dashboards, Motion)
what: Substantial outputs open beside the conversation as artifacts; since 2026-09-16 artifacts are typed templates (Docs, Slides, Design, Dashboards beta, Motion beta) plus legacy code/HTML artifacts that still render but cannot be newly created.
how: Artifacts require "Cloud code execution and file creation" capability; created via chat, the "Output" picker in the composer, or templates in the Artifacts tab; stored in a sidebar Artifacts tab; exportable (DOCX/PDF/MD/Google Docs, PPTX/Google Slides, ZIP/HTML, MP4).
verevonRelevance: Verevon should treat artifacts as first-class typed documents with their own storage, templates and export paths rather than ad-hoc code blocks.
notes: Legacy artifacts (pre 2026-09-16) remain publishable/embeddable; new ones are typed.

name: Inline "Edit with Claude" on highlighted text
what: In Docs/Markdown drafts the user highlights a passage and asks Claude to change just that section; across multiple Markdown files edit requests can be queued and sent as one batch.
how: Selection-anchored edit requests; batching of queued edits into one model turn.
verevonRelevance: Selection-scoped edits are a cheap, high-value UX for Verevon document artifacts; batching reduces model calls.
notes: Release note 2026-06-12 "Edit Claude's drafts in place".

name: Edit-message branching (preserves artifacts per branch)
what: Editing an earlier message creates a separate branch of the chat with its own artifacts; previous work is preserved. Retry on a reply forks an alternative answer. The UI shows branches via small arrows, not a tree.
how: Conversation stored as a tree; active path is what the model sees. No official branch-map UI; third-party extensions draw the tree.
verevonRelevance: Verevon can differentiate with a visible branch tree and per-branch artifact lineage.
notes: Branching is NOT yet available in the new unified experience (listed limitation in the one-Claude article).

name: Automatic context compaction for long conversations
what: When a chat nears the context limit Claude summarizes earlier messages so the conversation can continue; the full history is preserved and can still be referenced; user may see Claude "organizing its thoughts".
how: Requires code execution enabled; server-side summarization of older turns while keeping raw history retrievable.
verevonRelevance: Model Plane needs the same compaction primitive with retained raw history for search and audit.
notes: Announced 2025-11-24.

name: Context windows up to 1M tokens on paid plans
what: Length limits depend on model: newest models up to 1M tokens on paid plans, others 500K or 200K; part of the window is reserved for the response.
how: Per-model context budgets surfaced to the user; 1M beta first shipped with Sonnet 4.6 (2026-02-17).
verevonRelevance: Verevon model picker should expose per-model context budgets and reserve output space.

name: Projects (workspaces with knowledge, instructions, own memory)
what: Projects are self-contained workspaces with their own chat history, knowledge files, instructions and memory space; free users get 5, paid unlimited.
how: Project knowledge is cached (cheaper on reuse), RAG auto-enables when knowledge exceeds context (10x capacity), project-scoped memory and summary.
verevonRelevance: Maps to Verevon Spaces: scoped instructions + knowledge + memory, with auto-RAG fallback from Data Plane.

name: Project RAG auto-switch with visual indicator
what: When project knowledge approaches the context limit, Claude automatically switches to a project-knowledge search tool; a visual indicator shows a project is RAG-enabled; it switches back to in-context when knowledge shrinks.
how: Hybrid mode: in-context when it fits, retrieval tool otherwise; no user control.
verevonRelevance: Good pattern for Verevon: prefer full-context, fall back to retrieval transparently with a badge.

name: New Projects beta: one conversation fanning out to parallel cloud threads
what: A redesigned Projects (beta, Claude Code first, 2026-09-17) treats a project as one conversation where Claude splits work into parallel cloud threads, each a separate cloud session/branch/repo copy; user can open any thread to intervene.
how: Coordinator session spawns child cloud sessions; context passed between them; overlapping edits resolved like merge conflicts; usage drawn faster.
verevonRelevance: Directly relevant to Model Plane runs: a parent run that spawns parallel child runs with their own sandboxes and a merge step.
notes: Official article confirms existence; thread mechanics from press coverage.

name: Share chat with specific people (view-only snapshot)
what: Invite people by email to a private snapshot of a chat; snapshot includes artifacts, excludes files (unless in-org) and raw connector/MCP tool data; "Update shared chat" refreshes the snapshot; invites expire in 30 days.
how: Email-bound links; Settings > Privacy > Shared chats to review/revoke; Team/Enterprise restricted to org domain; audit logged.
verevonRelevance: Verevon sharing must snapshot and redact tool payloads; a "Space access never widens ACL" rule aligns with excluding files outside org.

name: Public links for shared chats (consumer only)
what: Free/Pro/Max can create anyone-with-the-link snapshots viewable without an account; noindex; view-only; can be turned off instantly.
how: Long random URLs + noindex; Team/Enterprise cannot create public links.
verevonRelevance: Low priority for Verevon (B2B) but org-internal share links matter.

name: Conversation list "Recents" merging chats and tasks; rename/delete/bulk delete
what: Quick questions and long tasks appear in one Recents list; conversations can be renamed, deleted, bulk-deleted via "Chats and tasks"; deletion purges backend within 30 days.
how: Sidebar list + full history page with multi-select.

notes: No folders, pins or archive documented.

name: Search past conversations (as a tool call)
what: Claude can search the user's earlier conversations and reference them; searches appear as visible tool calls; scoped to all non-project chats or to the current project; paid plans; toggle "Search and reference chats".
how: Chat-history search exposed as a model tool with scope rules; incognito chats excluded.
verevonRelevance: Verevon should expose session search as a model tool with Space scoping and visible tool-call cards.
notes: Launched 2025-08-11 for Max/Team/Enterprise.

name: Interactive input widgets (multiple choice / multi-select / ranking)

how: Model-emitted elicitation widgets rendered by the client; no third-party service.
verevonRelevance: Structured elicitation reduces round-trips; Verevon should support a typed "ask user" tool with option rendering.

name: Import from GitHub into chats/projects

verevonRelevance: Verevon upload limits and PDF tiering can mirror these numbers.

how: Custom visuals beta: Claude writes HTML; download as SVG/HTML/image or save as artifact.
verevonRelevance: Gap in claude.ai that Verevon can fill via multi-provider image models (Gemini/OpenAI) while keeping code-visuals.
notes: Quality 2 relative to ChatGPT/Gemini image generation.

name: Custom interactive visuals inline in chat

name: Cloud code execution and file creation (xlsx/pptx/docx/pdf)

name: Claude Docs (collaborative living documents)

name: Claude Motion (beta): code-generated animations exported to MP4

name: Voice mode (hands-free and push-to-talk) with tools

name: Web search image results

verevonRelevance: Minor.

how: Documentation-level routing guidance (not automatic).
